summary: Daytona's Startup Grid offers startups up to $50,000 in Daytona credits. The official page says startups receive $10,000 straight away on their account and can reach up to $50,000. Applicants submit the startup form for review.
claim_steps: Open the Daytona Startup Grid page.
Complete and submit the startup application form.
Wait for Daytona to review the application and respond.

social_proof.title: Daytona Startup Grid
social_proof.text: Get up to $50k in Daytona credits for your startup. Daytona says it gives startups $10K straight away on their account and easily up to $50K.
